description: This file contains a C implementation of cache management routines for a Linux kernel loader specific to Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX based boards. It includes definitions for cache operations like flushing the cache, using inline assembly for MIPS architecture. The file also references external headers for cache operations and configuration.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Flushes a specified memory region from CPU cache by performing writeback and invalidation operations.

ctags.name: flush_cache
ctags.pattern: /^void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr, unsigned long size)$/
